meaning: n. 预约；此处指约定时间的办事时段
en: My appointment is at three, but I have to work then.
zh: 我预约的是三点，但那时我得工作。
tip: an appointment at three：三点的预约。

meaning: v. 改期；为已经约好的事情另定时间
en: Could I reschedule my appointment for Thursday?
zh: 我能把预约改到星期四吗？
tip: reschedule an appointment for Thursday：把预约改到星期四。

en: Is there a morning slot on Thursday?
zh: 星期四上午有空余时段吗？
tip: an available slot：一个可用时段。

meaning: v. 回复；此处指答复对方提出的时段
en: I will reply to your message after checking my calendar.
zh: 我核对日历后会回复你的消息。
tip: reply to a message：回复一条消息。

meaning: v. 提醒；使人记起要做的事
en: Please remind me to bring the form on Thursday.
zh: 请提醒我星期四带上表格。
tip: remind someone to do something：提醒某人做某事。
